faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.description: Everything you need to know about monthly VM compute quotas, per-second VM rates, and extra-usage top-ups.

items.question: How does the monthly VM quota work?
items.answer: Plus ($10) and Pro ($25) include a monthly USD compute quota ($10 Plus, $25 Pro; Free includes $0.50) dedicated exclusively to Cloud VM runtime. You connect your own AI subscription (BYOS) or API keys (BYOK) at 0% platform markup.

items.question: How is Cloud Sandbox VM runtime billed?
items.answer: Active VMs deduct in USD directly from your monthly plan quota at $0.16/hr for 4-core (tier_1), $0.24/hr for 6-core (tier_2), and $0.32/hr for 8-core (tier_3)—metered per second. Stopped VMs cost strictly $0.00/hr.

items.question: How do I access Cloud Sandbox VMs on the Free plan?
items.answer: The Free plan includes a $0.50/mo compute quota for 4-core Cloud VMs ($0.16/hr). Complete standard account verification (Google/GitHub or phone) in Settings to unlock Cloud VM launches.

items.question: What happens if I exceed my plan quota?
items.answer: Your monthly plan quota is always consumed first—subscriptions unlock plan quotas rather than adding wallet cash, and running VMs stay online at $0.00 wallet balance while plan quota remains. When quota hits 0, overage is deducted from your extra-usage wallet (min $10.00 top-up).

items.question: Why is there a $10.00 minimum on extra-usage top-ups?
items.answer: Enforcing a $10.00 minimum top-up keeps payment processing overhead low so we don't charge you any extra fee at checkout. 100% of what you pay is credited directly to your non-expiring workspace balance.

items.question: How do I connect my own AI (BYOS / BYOK)?
items.answer: Sign in with Claude Pro/Max, ChatGPT Plus/Pro, or Antigravity inside your sandbox VM, or add OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, or custom API keys in Workspace Settings with 0% platform markup. We never charge for tokens.

faq.title: Everything you need to know about billing

items.q: How do the Free, Plus, and Pro plans work?
items.a: Each plan provides a monthly USD quota ($0.50 Free, $10 Plus, $25 Pro) for LLM tokens and Cloud VM runtime ($0.16–$0.32/hr). Pro covers all models; on Free and Plus, premium models are billed from your wallet.

items.q: What happens when I reach my monthly limit?
items.a: Your plan quota is always used first, and active VMs keep running at $0.00 wallet balance while quota remains. When you top up your extra-usage wallet (min $10.00, 0% fee), only quota overage is deducted from your non-expiring balance.

items.q: Do I pay for sandbox VMs when they are stopped?
items.a: No. Stopped machines cost strictly $0.00/hour. Compute metering runs per second only while a VM is booted and stops the second it is shut down.

items.q: Can I bring my own API keys (BYOK)?
items.a: Yes. In Settings > Provider Keys, you can add your own Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, or custom provider keys with 0% platform markup. BYOK requests do not consume plan allowance; on the Free plan at $0.00 wallet balance, paid models require wallet funds or a paid plan.
